# `NoDefaultValue`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Exception\NoDefaultValue`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy/blob/master/src/Exception/NoDefaultValue.php#L14) — **Version:** v0.7.2

**Extends:** `RuntimeException`

**Implements:** `Throwable`, `Stringable`, [`Exception\UnderstudyError`](/api/classes/Exception/UnderstudyError)

A loose understudy had to answer a call, but the declared return type has no
safe default. Understudy never invents one by calling an arbitrary
constructor and never hands back an uninitialised object.
